item.description: A preview of features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Trump waives Graham Act Russia sanctions, prompting lawmaker backlash
item.description: The new sanctions and tariffs were scheduled to take effect in two days.

item.title: Oregon school shooting suspect identified; had attended the elementary school, police say
item.description: Authorities say a shooter forced his way into a Bend, Oregon, elementary school and opened fire, killing three children and one teacher.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Starlink issues prevent Ukraine from intercepting drones
item.description: The Ukrainian president said Starlink problems are hindering the country's defensive efforts against Russian drones.
